items.quote: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
items.claim: A house with suspected plague must be isolated for seven days before follow-up inspection

items.quote: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
items.claim: On the seventh day, the priest performs a follow-up inspection to assess whether the plague has spread
